title: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — a graph over the fixture paper
title_zh: 合成夹具 —— 建立在夹具论文之上的图
summary: Not a real paper. This graph exists so the test suite has a valid input to build, break in specific ways, and round-trip.
summary_zh: 不是真论文。这张图的存在是为了让测试套件有一个可构建、可定向弄坏、可往返的合法输入。

nodes.label: 背景
nodes.detail: 夹具论文测得响应 3.45(2) 单位,样品质量 21.7 mg。
nodes.detail_en: The fixture paper measures a response of 3.45(2) units on a sample of mass 21.7 mg.
nodes.quote: An identical molecular field acts on all the sites

nodes.label: 问题
nodes.detail: 无序参数 x = 0.031,低于 40 K 偏离预期规律。
nodes.detail_en: The disorder parameter is x = 0.031 and below 40 K the response departs from the expected law.
nodes.quote: the response is substantial across the whole range

nodes.label: 方法
nodes.detail: 在 T = 12 K 测量。正文里出现一个 | 竖线 | 字符,用来测表格解析不会误吞。
nodes.detail_en: Measured at T = 12 K. This detail carries a | pipe | character on purpose, to check the table parser does not swallow prose.

nodes.label: 结论
nodes.quote: the widget is dominated by the third neighbour
